LanguageData.TurboTick_Prototype: Independent multiplayer protocol prototype: dedicated connection, speed settings sync and snapshot cache. Shared-colony, pawn and building command replication are still in development.
LanguageData.TurboTick_EnableDesc: In a room, enabled state, multiplier and cap require server confirmation together. Single-player preferences stay local.
LanguageData.TurboTick_ShowHudDesc: Actual completed TPS, target TPS, connection holds and server policy revision.
LanguageData.TurboTick_Held: Connection pending / lost: simulation held. Reconnect or leave the room in settings.
LanguageData.TurboTick_RoomPrototype: Room speed settings connected; shared-colony replication in development.
LanguageData.TurboTick_Local: Not in a room / local mode
LanguageData.TurboTick_LowTps: Below target TPS. Adjust the speed through the user or server.
LanguageData.TurboTick_StartShared: Publish current colony and start sharing
LanguageData.TurboTick_Enable: Enable extra multiplier (on by default, synced per room)
LanguageData.TurboTick_AutoRecoverDesc: Reconnect and catch up from the server checkpoint when divergence is detected. Off shows a notice only.
LanguageData.TurboTick_ExperimentalDesc: Replicates loading items into transport pods. Not verified in game; off by default.
LanguageData.TurboTick_EveryoneTrades: Allow everyone to trade and form caravans (unsynced)
LanguageData.TurboTick_EveryoneTradesDesc: By default only the host can trade or send out a caravan, keeping silver, goods and colonists consistent. Enabling this lets each player act locally, which can diverge.
LanguageData.TurboTick_NativeControls: In a room, the game's native pause, normal, fast and superfast buttons and key bindings synchronize by default. One player selects; all peers apply after server confirmation. Single-player keeps vanilla speeds.
